title: Expose watch-folder auto-run toggle on Libraries
summary: Add a Libraries-page control for the existing watch-folder settings so the operator can enable library-root detection and opt into gated Run Once auto-launch without leaving the Libraries workflow.
reason: The operator asked for the new-media auto-run feature to be available as a toggle on the Libraries UI.
behavior_before: Watch-folder detection and optional auto-launch were configurable from Settings / Paths & Safety and visible as read-only status on Schedule, but the Libraries page did not expose an obvious toggle.
behavior_after: The Libraries page exposes a watch-folder auto-run panel that stages the existing global EnableWatchFolders, WatchFolderRoots, WatchDebounceSeconds, WatchAction, and WatchRespectScheduleWindow keys through the backend settings preview/save flow.
